newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania'a parliament passed the 1997 state budget. The budget was approved by 230 votes to 157, with the opposition voting against.
The budget takes into account the difficult situation of the country's economy, Finance Minister Mircea Ciumara said.
* The Government started its session with debate focusing on banking laws.
* The Defence Ministry will cut some 10 percent from its staff, minister Victor Babiuc told a news conference.
Babiuc also said Romania's integration in NATO structures could cost between three and four billion dollars.
